en_title: 'It's Been a Sh*tshow' — Esports Casters Call for Change After Embark Studios Replaces Talent for The Finals' Grand Major Qualifier Highlight Reel With Game's AI Commentators
cn_title: 「一团糟」——Embark Studios在《THE FINALS》Grand Major预选赛集锦中用游戏AI解说取代专业人员，电竞解说呼吁改变
opus_summary: 《The Finals》大满贯亚太区封闭预选赛集锦使用游戏内AI解说取代原赛事解说，引发电竞解说员批评。Embark Studios已撤下视频，并取消以相同形式推出其他赛区集锦的计划。解说员Proto呼吁业内建立保护措施。

paragraphs.en: The Grand Major, an official tournament for Embark Studios' first-person shooter The Finals, is at the center of a heated debate after the developer replaced its real-life esports casters with AI commentators in a now-deleted highlight reel.
paragraphs.cn: Embark Studios旗下第一人称射击游戏《THE FINALS》的官方赛事Grand Major正处于一场激烈争议的中心，此前开发商在一段现已删除的集锦视频中用AI解说取代了真人电竞解说。

paragraphs.en: Embark Studios is facing backlash after a now-deleted video was uploaded to The Finals' official social media accounts recapping highlights from The Grand Major’s APAC Closed Qualifiers. The audio commentary that played over the video is at the center of this blowback, as the casters who originally commentated these matches were replaced by the game's fictional AI commentators, Scotty and June. While this video has since been removed from public viewing, remarks from casters in the community paint a grim picture of what they saw.
paragraphs.cn: Embark Studios正面临强烈批评，此前《THE FINALS》的官方社交媒体账号上传了一段回顾Grand Major亚太地区封闭预选赛精彩片段的视频，该视频现已删除。视频中播放的解说音频是这场风波的焦点，因为原本解说这些比赛的解说员被游戏中的虚构AI解说Scotty和June取代。尽管公众现在已无法观看这段视频，但社区解说员的言论描绘出他们所见到的严峻情况。

paragraphs.en: “After four cycles, open/closed [qualifiers], the time, effort, passion, and emotion myself, @TheeHyperactive, and @bluepanda_casts put in, we get replaced by two AI casters who even quote us. I get they are a part of the game, but yikes. Thanks @reachthefinals,” commentator Proto / Kai wrote in a viral post on Twitter/X.
paragraphs.cn: 「在经历四个周期、公开／封闭预选赛，以及我、@TheeHyperactive和@bluepanda_casts投入的时间、精力、热情和感情之后，我们却被两个AI解说取代了，它们甚至还引用了我们的话。我明白它们是游戏的一部分，但这也太糟了。谢谢你，@reachthefinals。」解说员Proto / Kai在X上一则广为传播的帖子中写道。

paragraphs.en: After 4 cycles, open/closed quals, the time, effort, passion and emotion myself @TheeHyperactive and @bluepanda_casts put in. We get replaced by two Ai casters who even quote us :/ I get they are apart of the game but yikes. Thanks @reachthefinals https://t.co/oC8Zb5GrU0
paragraphs.cn: 在经历4个周期、公开／封闭预选赛，以及我、@TheeHyperactive和@bluepanda_casts投入的时间、精力、热情和感情之后。我们却被两个AI解说取代了，它们甚至还引用了我们的话 :/ 我明白它们是游戏的一部分，但这也太糟了。谢谢你，@reachthefinals https://t.co/oC8Zb5GrU0

paragraphs.en: Caster Bluepanda also spoke out on the situation, writing , “For nearly seven years I've been repeatedly told that my work is valued and appreciated, only to then have the same people saying those things turn around and either completely ghost me or tell me they're going in a different direction with talent and that my services aren't needed. GG.”
paragraphs.cn: 解说员Bluepanda也就此事发声，写道：「近七年来，我反复被告知我的工作受到重视和赞赏，但说这些话的同一批人转过头来，要么彻底不再理我，要么告诉我他们在人选方面要走不同的方向，不再需要我的服务。GG。」

paragraphs.en: The ordeal soon caught fire within the general esports scene, with casters from various competitive gaming communities speaking out against Embark's decision to use AI as a replacement for the actual casters whose knowledge, charisma, and talent are being trained on without their knowledge or consent.
paragraphs.cn: 这场风波很快在整个电竞圈引发热议，来自不同竞技游戏社区的解说员纷纷发声，反对Embark决定用AI取代真人解说，而这些解说员的知识、个人魅力和才能正在他们不知情或未同意的情况下被用于训练。

paragraphs.en: “Oh! Esports has AI casters now! Haha! I am appalled. These REAL casters deserve better, and stealing their quotes is disgusting. Y’know what’s worse? THE CASTING IS TERRIBLE. Everyone involved in making this should be embarrassed,” Marvel Rivals caster LemonKiwi wrote .
paragraphs.cn: 「哦！电竞现在有AI解说了！哈哈！我惊呆了。这些真正的解说员应该得到更好的对待，偷用他们的话令人作呕。知道更糟糕的是什么吗？解说烂透了。所有参与制作的人都应该感到羞耻。」《漫威争锋》解说员LemonKiwi写道。

paragraphs.en: “AI casters trained on the actual casters is devious, damn,” fighting game commentator Damascus tweeted . “Every day we keep moving towards the absolute slop era.”
paragraphs.cn: 「用真人解说训练AI解说，太阴险了，该死。」格斗游戏解说员Damascus发帖写道，「我们每天都在朝着彻头彻尾的垃圾内容时代迈进。」

paragraphs.en: Some players are pointing to a new feature for The Finals that was announced back in October called Dynamic Commentary . It uses the game’s pre-existing, fictional commentators Scotty and June, who are now able to refer to players by their screen names and even call out specific moments in individual matches based on the context of what’s happening in the game.
paragraphs.cn: 一些玩家提到了《THE FINALS》早在10月公布的一项名为动态解说的新功能。该功能使用游戏中已有的虚构解说Scotty和June，它们现在能够用玩家的屏幕名称称呼玩家，甚至可以根据游戏中正在发生的情况，解说具体比赛中的特定时刻。

paragraphs.en: It's worth noting that the voices of Scotty and June were provided by human voice actors who were paid by Embark for their work. However, their lines are driven by a text-to-speech program and an artificial intelligence model that was trained on their voices, leading some players to argue that the writing for this AI esports commentary debacle has been on the wall for some time now.
paragraphs.cn: 值得注意的是，Scotty和June的声音由真人配音演员提供，Embark为他们的工作支付了报酬。不过，它们的台词由文本转语音程序和使用配音演员声音训练的人工智能模型驱动，这让一些玩家认为，这场AI电竞解说风波早已有了预兆。

paragraphs.en: I reached out to Embark Studios for comment on the situation. In its response, the company explained that it had chosen to use Scotty and June to introduce The Grand Major due to players' familiarity with the characters, but ultimately decided that this wasn't the right direction to take, given the hard work provided by the matches' original commentators and talent. The full statement can be read below:
paragraphs.cn: 我联系了Embark Studios，请其就此事置评。该公司在回应中解释说，之所以选择用Scotty和June来介绍Grand Major，是因为玩家熟悉这两个角色，但考虑到比赛原解说员及其他专业人员付出的辛勤工作，最终认定这并非正确的方向。完整声明如下：

paragraphs.en: "Yesterday, we released a recap video of THE FINALS APAC Closed Qualifier, narrated by Scotty and June, using familiar characters to introduce more players to THE FINALS esports ahead of The Grand Major. The video was a highlight recap, and our team selected clips from the broadcast, wrote an original script and produced new commentary for Scotty and June. However, leaving out the casters and talent who made that broadcast wasn’t the right call. We’ve taken the video down, and the AMER and EMEA recaps in the same format will no longer be released. We’re grateful to our talent for their candid feedback."
paragraphs.cn: 「昨天，我们发布了一段由Scotty和June解说的《THE FINALS》亚太地区封闭预选赛回顾视频，借助玩家熟悉的角色，在Grand Major开始前向更多玩家介绍《THE FINALS》电竞赛事。这段视频是精彩片段回顾，我们的团队从赛事转播中挑选了片段，撰写了原创脚本，并为Scotty和June制作了新的解说。不过，遗漏参与制作那场转播的解说员和专业人员并非正确的决定。我们已经下架了视频，同样形式的美洲地区及欧洲、中东和非洲地区回顾视频也将不再发布。我们感谢专业人员坦诚的反馈。」

paragraphs.en: Oscar Lundberg, Competitive Experience and Community at Embark Studios and The Finals, published a statement on his personal Twitter/X account responding to the blowback, as well.
paragraphs.cn: Embark Studios及《THE FINALS》竞技体验与社区工作人员Oscar Lundberg也在个人X账号上发表声明，回应了这场风波。

paragraphs.en: "Yesterday we released a recap of the APAC Closed Qualifier that left out the casters and talent who made that event. That was a mistake, and I’m sorry," he wrote . "We intended for Scotty and June to help bring more casual interest into THE FINALS esports ahead of TGM. That was the goal, but the work of our talent deserved to be included and highlighted, and it wasn’t. The video is down and won’t return in this form. The AMER and EMEA recaps planned in the same format won’t go out as planned either, and we’re rethinking all three."
paragraphs.cn: 「昨天，我们发布了一段亚太地区封闭预选赛回顾视频，遗漏了参与制作那场赛事的解说员和专业人员。这是一个错误，我很抱歉。」他写道，「我们本打算让Scotty和June在TGM开始前帮助《THE FINALS》电竞赛事吸引更多普通观众的兴趣。这是我们的目标，但我们专业人员的工作本应被纳入并得到突出展示，实际却并非如此。视频已经下架，不会以这种形式重新发布。原计划采用相同形式的美洲地区及欧洲、中东和非洲地区回顾视频也不会按计划发布，我们正在重新考虑这三段视频。」

paragraphs.en: I also spoke with two of the commentators who worked on The Finals' competitive circuit, both of whom were not chosen to commentate The Grand Major despite providing their talents for multiple tournaments leading up to the event. As Lundberg mentioned, this was just one of three highlight videos planned for each competing region using this type of AI audio commentary in place of the actual casters.
paragraphs.cn: 我还与两位参与过《THE FINALS》竞技赛事的解说员交谈，尽管他们在Grand Major之前的多场赛事中提供了专业服务，但两人都没有被选中解说Grand Major。正如Lundberg所提到的，这只是原计划为各参赛地区制作的三段集锦视频之一，这些视频都将使用这种AI音频解说取代真人解说。

paragraphs.en: "Embark saw no issue with this until they received overwhelming global backlash and even then their response was essentially, 'Whoopsie, we didn't think people would mind,'" Bluepanda told me. "It says to me that they're not really sorry at all. I'm done with the game and esports as a whole at this stage, the effort we put in and the amount of bulls**t we have to deal with, especially in OCE, just isn't worth it anymore."
paragraphs.cn: 「Embark在遭到全球铺天盖地的批评之前，都没觉得这有什么问题，即便到了那时，他们的回应基本上也是：『哎呀，我们没想到大家会介意。』」Bluepanda告诉我，「这让我觉得他们根本没有真正感到抱歉。到了这个阶段，我对这款游戏和整个电竞行业都已经彻底失望了，我们投入的精力和必须应付的一大堆破事，尤其是在大洋洲，已经完全不值得了。」

paragraphs.en: Proto, who commented all four cycles throughout the year, on top of working the open and closed qualifiers, echoed this sentiment and relayed how the situation was explained to him by Embark's organizers.
paragraphs.cn: 除了解说公开和封闭预选赛，Proto还解说了全年全部四个周期的比赛。他也表达了类似看法，并转述了Embark的组织者向他解释的情况。

paragraphs.en: "It's definitely pretty tragic that they assumed that would be the right step forward," he said. "...They had an idea of the story that they wanted to tell for the teams and the qualifier. They looked through the VOD, found clips and moments that told that story, then wrote a script of what they roughly wanted Scotty and June to say. The script was handed off to an individual who writes the script, and then the line creation was done, and they didn't feed the VOD itself into the AI, but essentially they still ripped parts of the VOD of things that we said, which is why they copy things we said."
paragraphs.cn: 「他们以为那会是正确的前进方向，这确实相当令人痛心。」他说，「……他们对自己想讲述的有关队伍和预选赛的故事有一个想法。他们看遍了点播录像，找出能讲述这个故事的片段和时刻，然后大致写下他们想让Scotty和June说什么。脚本被交给了一名撰写脚本的人，随后完成了台词制作，他们没有把点播录像本身输入AI，但本质上他们还是从录像中拿走了我们说过的部分内容，这就是为什么它们复制了我们说过的话。」

paragraphs.en: Proto went on to warn others in the industry that this debacle could be the proverbial canary in the coal mine for esports talent; much like the AI-generated menus we now see plastered on the exterior every restaurant, it's possible that one day, esports circuits no longer see the point in paying for flesh and blood talent when an AI is far cheaper.
paragraphs.cn: Proto接着警告业内其他人，这场风波可能是电竞专业人员的危险预警；就像我们如今看到每家餐厅外面贴满的AI生成菜单一样，有朝一日，电竞赛事可能会认为，既然AI便宜得多，就没有必要再花钱聘请有血有肉的专业人员。

paragraphs.en: "Opening that door is almost like Pandora's Box," Proto said. "As soon as it opens and people think that this is something that can be done, it creates problems for the talent who are pouring their heart and soul into these broadcasts. It just essentially takes away any kind of relevance from us in terms of, 'Why did we even bother?' I mean, they paid us to do this show. ...It was decent money. Why would you throw that away to dub us over with AI? It just didn't make any sense. And in terms of the longevity of the scene, I think this definitel opens up the ability for people now to experiment with [AI], if that's what they want to do, they can get rid of their talents."
paragraphs.cn: 「打开那扇门几乎就像打开潘多拉魔盒。」Proto说，「一旦它被打开，人们认为这是一件可以做的事，就会给那些为这些转播倾注全部心血的专业人员带来问题。这本质上剥夺了我们存在的任何意义，让人觉得：『我们当初何必费这个劲？』我的意思是，他们付钱让我们做这场节目。……报酬还不错。为什么要把这些丢在一边，用AI给我们的解说配音？这根本说不通。就这个领域的长远发展而言，我认为这肯定为人们现在尝试使用AI打开了大门，如果他们想这么做，就可以把专业人员换掉。」

paragraphs.en: As far as next steps are concerned, Proto says that all esports talent — be that casters, producers, broadcasters, camera operators, or even PAs — need to create a union to protect themselves from this exact type of mishap.
paragraphs.cn: 至于接下来该怎么办，Proto表示，所有电竞专业人员——无论是解说员、制作人、转播人员、摄像师，甚至制作助理——都需要成立工会，以保护自己免受此类事件的影响。

paragraphs.en: "I think industry wide, we definitely need to implement some kind of protection for commentary teams as well as production teams," he said. "There has to be some kind of something set up, whether it's a union, whether it's a global talent hiatus. We'll turn around and say, 'We're not doing this until people send us contracts that essentially ban the use of our voices in generative AI.' But this is why I include production, as well. If we've got people making streaming broadcasting packages or people running production on the back end of things, switching all the cameras, doing the observing, there are features that have auto-AI observe like in Counter-Strike , you can follow people from that third person perspective or even in the finals when people die, the camera will sort of just start flicking between people automatically. You got to protect those people's jobs."
paragraphs.cn: 「我认为在整个行业范围内，我们肯定需要为解说团队和制作团队实施某种保护措施。」他说，「必须建立某种机制，无论是工会，还是全球专业人员集体停工。我们会直接说：『在有人给我们发来基本上禁止将我们的声音用于生成式AI的合同之前，我们不会做这件事。』但这也是我把制作人员也包括在内的原因。如果有人在制作直播转播素材包，或者有人在后台负责制作、切换所有摄像机、担任导播，那么现在已经有了AI自动观战功能，比如在《反恐精英》中，你可以从第三人称视角跟随玩家；甚至在《THE FINALS》中，当有人死亡时，镜头也会开始自动在玩家之间切换。你必须保护这些人的工作。」

paragraphs.en: But where Embark is concerned, Proto is calling for immediate and sweeping change. This includes widening the talent pool for major tournaments, providing a "more streamlined" version of next year's competitive events, and supporting local communities to keep the game's competitive scene alive.
paragraphs.cn: 但就Embark而言，Proto呼吁立即进行全面改革。这包括扩大大型赛事的专业人员人才库，为明年的竞技赛事提供「更加精简」的版本，以及支持本地社区，让游戏的竞技生态得以延续。

paragraphs.en: "Everything has just been handled so poorly consistently to the point where even the talent announcement for the major, everybody wasn't happy. It's just been, and I say this brazenly, it's been a sh*t show. It's been a sh*t show," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 「所有事情一直都处理得非常糟糕，以至于就连Major的专业人员名单公布时，大家也都不满意。这简直就是——我直言不讳地说——一团糟。一团糟。」他说。

paragraphs.en: The Finals isn’t the only game from Embark that uses AI; Arc Raiders also utilizes artificial intelligence for voice lines that, similar to The Finals’ Dynamic Commentary, are able to call out specific items and locations.
paragraphs.cn: 《THE FINALS》并不是Embark唯一使用AI的游戏；《ARC Raiders》也在语音台词中使用人工智能，与《THE FINALS》的动态解说类似，这些台词能够说出具体物品和地点。

paragraphs.en: In a November 2025 interview with PCGamesN , design director Virgil Watkins explained that Embark had “hire[d] and contract[ed] voice actors for it,” saying it was “part of their contract that we use [AI] for this purpose, and that allows us to do things like our ping system, where it's capable of saying every single item name, every single location name, and compass directions. That's how we can get that without needing to have someone come in every time we create a new item for the game."
paragraphs.cn: 在2025年11月接受PCGamesN采访时，设计总监Virgil Watkins解释说，Embark「为此雇用了配音演员并与他们签订了合同」，他说：「我们为此目的使用AI是他们合同的一部分，这让我们能够制作标记系统之类的功能，使其能够说出每一个物品名称、每一个地点名称和罗盘方位。这样一来，我们每次为游戏制作新物品时，就不需要请人来配音也能实现这一点。」

paragraphs.en: Overall, it seems that most fans are in agreement that using AI for NPCs and player character dialogue is one thing, but replacing real-life commentators who poured hours into analysis with AI is another ball of wax, entirely.
paragraphs.cn: 总体而言，大多数粉丝似乎都认同，将AI用于NPC和玩家角色的对话是一回事，但用AI取代花费数小时进行分析的真人解说员，则完全是另一回事。
